career_ladder.note: Judicial officers in Chhattisgarh are governed by the Chhattisgarh Lower Judicial Service (Recruitment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2006 and the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) uniform pay matrix as mandated by the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India. Officers progress through Assured Career Progression (ACP) increments at 5-year intervals and promotional cadres up to the High Court.

exam_scheme.note: The Chhattisgarh Judicial Service (Civil Judge Entry Level) Examination is conducted in three stages: Preliminary Examination (Online/Offline Objective screening test), Main Examination (Conventional descriptive written paper focusing on Judgment Writing and Translation), and Viva-Voce (Personality Test).

papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 33% (approx. 5 marks) for Unreserved candidates; minimum 25% (approx. 3.75 marks) for SC/ST/OBC candidates; candidates shortlisted in 1:3 ratio of vacancies

financial_package.note: Judicial officers in Chhattisgarh receive remuneration governed by the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) uniform pay matrix as mandated by the Supreme Court of India in All India Judges Association v. Union of India. Pay Scale Level J-1 is ₹77,840 - ₹1,36,520 with judicial perks and allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) & High Court of Chhattisgarh Bilaspur
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary computed from Level J-1 entry basic ₹77,840 + 58% DA (₹45,147) + judicial HRA (8%–16% or official government judicial bungalow) + judicial sumptuary, robe, medical, conveyance, and domestic help allowances. In-hand estimate reflects standard statutory deductions including 10% NPS (Basic + DA), GIS, and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Official designated judicial residence / government bungalow in posting district
Sumptuary allowance and robe allowance per SNJPC recommendations
Conveyance allowance / official vehicle with driver and fuel entitlement
Medical facilities and reimbursement for officer and dependent family members
Electricity and water charge reimbursement up to prescribed monthly units
Residential orderly / attendant allowance and telephone/broadband reimbursement
